title: Gaussian coordinate invariance moments
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the coordinate function $z\mapsto z_i$ on $\mathbb R^n$, under product standard Gaussian measure, satisfies the invariance moment conditions: it is $9$-reasonable, has mean zero, second moment one, and third moment zero.
